request.prompt: def quicksort(arr):

choices.text:
if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr
    pivot = arr[len(arr) // 2]
    left = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]
    middle = [x for x in arr if x == pivot]
    right = [x for x in arr if x > pivot]
    return quicksort(left) + middle + quicksort(right)

# Example usage
arr = [3, 6, 8, 10, 1, 2, 1]
print(quicksort(arr))  # Output: [1,
